environment.description: legume-gme 是用于二维光子晶体层和激子-光子体系的可微平面波展开与导模展开库，提供晶格、层、几何形状、光子晶体、PWE/GME 求解器、场与辐射损耗计算，以及基于自动微分的参数优化。结果依赖基组截断和收敛设置。

function.name: set_run_options
function.description: Set multiple options for the guided-mode expansion.

gmode_compute.description: Define whether the guided modes are computed exactly at every k-step ('exact'), or computed in the beginning and then interpolated ('interp').

gmode_inds.description: Indexes of modes to be included in the expansion. Default is [0].

gmode_npts.description: Number of points over which guided modes are computed. Default is 1000.

gmode_step.description: Step in frequency in the search for guided mode solutions. Default is 1e-2.

gmode_tol.description: Tolerance in the minimum and maximum frequency value when looking for the guided-mode solutions. Default is 1e-10.

numeig.description: Number of eigen-frequencies to be stored (starting from lowest). Default is 10.

compute_im.description: Should the imaginary parts of the frequencies also be computed. Default is True.

eig_sigma.description: Target eigenvalue; numeig eigenvalues closest to eig_sigma are stored. Default is 0.

eps_eff.description: Using the 'average', 'background' or a 'custom' permittivity of the layers in the guided mode computation. If 'custom', all the photonic crystal layers, including the claddings, must have a pre-set ``eps_eff``.

verbose.description: Print information at intermediate steps. Default is True.

kz_symmetry.description: Symmetry seleced with respect to the vertical kz plane of incidence, it can be 'both', 'odd', 'even' or None. With None there is no symmetry sepeartion, and :attr:`GuidedModeExp.kz_symms` is an empty list. If 'both', both even and odd modes are saved in attr:`GuidedModeExp.freqs` and their parity wrt the veritcal plane are saved in :attr:`GuidedModeExp.kz_symms`. With 'even' ('odd') only 'even' ('odd') modes are calculated and stored. Default is None.

symm_thr.description: Threshold for out-of-diagonal terms in odd/even separated Hamiltonian. Default is 1e-8.

delta_gx.description: little component added to the x-component of vectors g = k + G to avoid problems at g = 0. Default is 1e-15.

delta_gabs.description: small shift of the absolute value of g = k + G , kept for backwards compatibility. Default is 1e-15.

use_sparse.description: If True, use sparse matrices for separating even and odd modes w.r.t. the vertical plane of symmetry. Default is False.

only_gmodes.description: Should only the guided modes computed withouth the coupling of the PhC periodic patterning. Default is False.

function.name: run
function.description: Compute the eigenmodes of the photonic crystal structure.  The guided-mode expansion proceeds as follows:  Compute the inverse matrix of the fourier transform of the permittivity in every phc layer.  Iterate over the k points:  Compute the guided modes over all the (g + k) points.  Compute the Hermitian matrix for diagonalization.  Compute the real part of the eigenvalues, stored in :attr:`GuidedModeExp.freqs`, and the corresponding eigenvectors, stored in :attr:`GuidedModeExp.eigvecs`.  If compute_im=True (as is default), run :meth:`GuidedModeExp.run_im`. If kz_symmetry = 'odd', 'even' or 'both' calculates symmetries for each k, and imaginary part of frequencies of both polarizations if kz_symmetry = odd' or 'even' calculates imaginary part of 'odd' or 'even' modes.

kpoints.description: numpy array of shape (2, :) with the [kx, ky] coordinates of the k-vectors over which the simulation is run.

angles.description: This is needed only in case symmetry is differnet from None. Numpy array with direction angle in kx-ky plane of kpoints.

kwargs.description: All the keyword arguments that can be passed here, as well as their default values, are defined in :meth:`GuidedModeExp.set_run_options`.

function.ori_input: self, kpoints: np.ndarray = np.array([[0], [0]]), angles: np.ndarray = np.array([]), **kwargs
function.ori_description: Compute the eigenmodes of the photonic crystal structure.  The guided-mode expansion proceeds as follows:  Compute the inverse matrix of the fourier transform of the permittivity in every phc layer.  Iterate over the k points:  Compute the guided modes over all the (g + k) points.  Compute the Hermitian matrix for diagonalization.  Compute the real part of the eigenvalues, stored in :attr:`GuidedModeExp.freqs`, and the corresponding eigenvectors, stored in :attr:`GuidedModeExp.eigvecs`.  If compute_im=True (as is default), run :meth:`GuidedModeExp.run_im`. If kz_symmetry = 'odd', 'even' or 'both' calculates symmetries for each k, and imaginary part of frequencies of both polarizations if kz_symmetry = odd' or 'even' calculates imaginary part of 'odd' or 'even' modes.  Parameters ---------- kpoints : np.ndarray, optional numpy array of shape (2, :) with the [kx, ky] coordinates of the k-vectors over which the simulation is run. angles : np.ndarray, optional This is needed only in case symmetry is differnet from None. Numpy array with direction angle in kx-ky plane of kpoints.  **kwargs All the keyword arguments that can be passed here, as well as their default values, are defined in :meth:`GuidedModeExp.set_run_options`.

markeredgewidth.description: Band marker edge border width. Default is 1.5.

a.description: Lattice constant in [m], this parameters is required if eV == True. Default is None
